scoring_note: Weights are our transcription of the public classic-format scoring rules. Sites change rules; every weight we used is in this payload, so check it against your contest before you trust it.

roster_templates.label: Full: P, C/1B, 2B, 3B, SS, 3 OF, UTIL

salaries.note: Salaries come from you. We do not scrape or republish any site's salary feed. Paste the CSV your contest site exports, or type a handful of prices in by hand; both stay in your browser.

notes: Skill projections (K, BB, HR, hits, innings, plate appearances) come from the rest-of-season engine behind the Redraft board. Nothing new is fit here.
Per-game playing time, the matchup multiplier and the park leg are display layer estimates with published league anchors. Each row lists them in `est`.
Relievers are not on the slate. Save and hold chances are not knowable before first pitch, and pretending otherwise would be the least honest number on the page.
Park factors: the committed artifact covers the minor league ladder only, so every MLB park leg is neutral today and labelled as such.

The matchup multiplier is the inverse of an innings-weighted opponent pitching index (5.4 of 9 innings to the announced starter's SEM+, the rest to the bullpen's Bullpen+), clamped. It mirrors the opponent term the streamer board has always used. It is a display heuristic, not a fitted run-environment model, and no backtest stands behind it yet.
